## Summary

Explain the focused change and link any existing issue. Search for related work before opening a duplicate.

## Evidence and verification

- Reproduction, expected behavior, and actual behavior:
- Relevant book, song/arrangement or edition, build and settings:
- Source edition/page and human comparison for any musical change:
- Local build and native-browser checks actually completed:
- Known limitations, skipped checks, and remaining hypotheses:
- AI assistance used, if any, and what a human independently verified:

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I reviewed this submission and am authorized to submit it.
- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and preserved source-bound safeguards and edition-specific licenses.
- [ ] I included no credentials, personal data, private reports, private scans, generated build output or owner deployment configuration.
- [ ] Any musical correction is supported by human comparison with the authoritative source, not AI output or a different edition alone.

There is no automated test-suite prerequisite or GitHub Actions workflow. State the current build and manual checks honestly; do not invent listening, device, or source-verification results.
